## E13(d) waterfall, finished with P1F (descriptive)

Steps: released path (W1 last_randinit, upstream scoring) -> init (W1 last) -> probe (P1E) -> test scoring (P1E re-scored: grid windows, overlap labels; E13(a)) -> train labels (P1F: probe trained and validated on overlap labels, same test windows and labels as the scoring step) -> split (D24-A rotations, 3-seed means; E13's endpoint). SA gain = SA arm - lp of the same cell. ROC x100; [95% CI: seeds / rotations resampled jointly, NO test-window resampling, so narrower than E13's event/subject CIs for the same cells (decompose/waterfall.md); P1F has no npz here].
